previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: Nested plan records execute unchecked validate methods before their exact type/hash is established
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: A custom plan/fixture/trigger object is passed at the public producer/action boundary.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: NativeProducer.run calls plan.validate without an exact NativePlan check. NativePlan.validate calls self.fixture.validate and Action.validate calls self.trigger.validate before checking their concrete Source types. A custom method can execute arbitrary or blocking effects before canonical hash validation; Action itself is checked but the nested records are not.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Reject non-exact NativeRuntime/NativePlan/FixtureSpec/Action/Trigger and malformed sequence/scalar shapes before calling any supplied method or canonicalization. Keep validation Source-owned and perform it before directory/native/resource effects.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Static malformed-constructor/type boundary defect; no custom object or function was executed.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Exact Source NativeRuntime/NativePlan/FixtureSpec/Action/Trigger and exact bounded scalar/sequence shapes before supplied methods, hash or effects. Source-owned validators invoked explicitly; nested custom records cannot call validate.
